description: What to do on one day of the signed-in traveller's plan: places near that day's hotel (or its town, when the hotel cannot be placed), ranked for THIS traveller the way the app's For You list ranks them: their travel preferences, how full the day already is for their pace, what the rest of the trip already holds (no fourth museum in a row), what they have planned on past trips, and how famous and how well travellers rate each place. Each place comes with why (the reason it is on the list for them, in the app's words), must_see, distance_miles from the anchor, its description, and its Meridian Dispatch page when it has one. Places already on the plan are left out. The ranking draws only on the Meridian Dispatch guides, so a thin town gives a short list; notes says what the ranking could not know (it cannot see the traveller's photo journal, so a place they have been can still appear). Pass day as the day number from the plan's first date (1 is the first day), or date. Use get_plan first if you need the plan id or the day. Needs sign-in.

date.description: Or the day's date, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of day.

day.description: Which day, counted from the plan's first date: 1 is the first day. Default 1.

name: suggest_for_my_day
title: Suggest places for a day of my plan
